instruction: Pour the liquid from the bottle into the cup.

frames.label: turn 1: Task rule: pour all the wine into the mug, then stand the bottle upright again well clear of the mug - the result is judged the moment the bottle comes back upright, so by then the mug must hold the wine and the bottle must be empty and standing away from it. Order: (1) grip the bottle by its NECK from the side, fingers held out horizontally so the pads lie across the neck and leave the mouth clear; (2) carry it upright and high to a clear spot to the left of the mug, and tip it over THERE, while it is still sealed and nothing can run out; (3) move the tipped bottle until its mouth is directly above the middle of the mug's opening BEFORE tipping any further; (4) tip on until the mouth points down, and then hold it there, still, over the mug until the stream has stopped and the wine has settled in the mug - standing the bottle up while it is still running is what leaves wine in it and spills the rest; (5) only then lift clear, carry it back beside the mug and stand it upright. Now on step 1 of 5: take the bottle by its neck, from the side. The bottle is still standing on the table, upright, and its mouth is nowhere near the mug. open the right gripper, hold the fingers out horizontally and travel above the bottle neck
